# Game and Action Requirements Checklist: Guess the Shortest Path

**Purpose**: Review the clarity, completeness, and consistency of game and action requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [Feature specification](../spec.md) | [Action contract](../contracts/game-actions.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `/speckit.checklist` from the feature context.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality has been reviewed and satisfied, not that implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the inputs, success outcomes, and expected failures specified for each game operation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Contract §Operations]
  - PASS: The [operations table and guards](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) define inputs, results, and failures for all four operations.
- [x] CHK002 Are challenge eligibility, distinct endpoints, and the minimum route length defined without exposing prohibited information? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-003, §FR-015]
  - PASS: [FR-001–FR-003 and FR-015](../spec.md#functional-requirements) specify eligibility and disclosure restrictions.
- [x] CHK003 Are initial attempt state, guess history, route, current stop, and completion result defined for each relevant stage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004–FR-008, §FR-012]
  - PASS: The [attempt data model](../data-model.md#attempt-and-guesses) defines initial state, history, and completion.
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements for retrieving the predefined challenge identifier sufficiently specified for a future client? [Completeness, Gap, Contract §Operations]
  - PASS: [Challenge retrieval](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) requires no input and returns the ID used to start an attempt.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are route length, stop position, directionality, and the treatment of repeated stops defined unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-014]
  - PASS: [Edge cases](../spec.md#edge-cases) and [assumptions](../spec.md#assumptions) define direction, positions, repeats, and hop counts.
- [x] CHK006 Are the conditions for connected and optimal-position marks independently and precisely defined, including tied shortest routes and detours? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-014]
  - PASS: [FR-007 and FR-014](../spec.md#functional-requirements) define connectivity and route-independent optimal positions; [edge cases](../spec.md#edge-cases) cover ties.
- [x] CHK007 Are input validity constraints and failure precedence sufficiently specified for each applicable operation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Contract §Operations]
  - PASS: The [action contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) specifies identifier and revision validation and guess error precedence.
- [x] CHK008 Are revision changes and stale-state outcomes specified for both connected and unconnected guesses? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Operations]
  - PASS: Every known guess increments the revision, and stale guesses return the latest snapshot without mutation ([contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations)).

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the challenge details in the action contract provide the endpoint identifiers and names required by the specification? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Operations]
  - PASS: The [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) guarantees both endpoint IDs resolve to uniquely named entries in `stops`.
- [x] CHK010 Are unconnected guesses consistently described as recorded without advancing the accepted route or affecting its final classification? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007–FR-008, Contract §Operations]
  - PASS: [FR-007–FR-008](../spec.md#functional-requirements) and the [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) record unconnected guesses without advancing the route.
- [x] CHK011 Are error categories, precedence, and state preservation consistent between the specification and action contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-009, §FR-013, Contract §Shared response shapes]
  - PASS: [FR-006, FR-009, and FR-013](../spec.md#functional-requirements) and the [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) define unavailable-challenge outcomes, precedence, and unchanged state.
- [x] CHK012 Are expected business failures and technical failures distinguished consistently with the constitution's explicit-outcome and guard-first principles? [Consistency, Constitution §VI, Contract §Game Server Actions]
  - PASS: The [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md) specifies Results, guarded mutations, and sanitized technical exceptions, matching [constitution §VI](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md#vi-explicit-outcomes-and-guard-first-control-flow).

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are the eligibility and shortest-route success criteria objective enough to distinguish compliant from noncompliant challenges and results? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-002]
  - PASS: [SC-001–SC-002](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes), read with the functional rules, define objective eligibility and classification checks.
- [x] CHK014 Do acceptance criteria cover each documented operation and distinguish unavailable, malformed, stale, and completed outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003–SC-004, Gap]
  - PASS: [SC-005–SC-006](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes) cover all operations, failure categories, and rejected-guess preservation.
- [x] CHK015 Are the boundaries of the representative classification cases sufficiently specified to make the stated 100% criterion meaningful? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Ambiguity]
  - PASS: [SC-002](../spec.md#measurable-outcomes) lists required classification cases and expected checks.

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are requirements complete for shortest and longer routes, ties, detours, repeated stops, and dead ends? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, §Edge Cases]
  - PASS: [User Story 2](../spec.md#user-story-2---guess-stops-and-complete-a-route-priority-p1) and [edge cases](../spec.md#edge-cases) cover these routes and dead ends.
- [x] CHK017 Are unknown stops, malformed identifiers, unavailable challenges or attempts, and guesses after completion addressed without ambiguous state changes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008–FR-009, §FR-012]
  - PASS: [FR-006, FR-008–FR-009, and FR-012](../spec.md#functional-requirements) and the [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) specify rejection and unchanged state.
- [x] CHK018 Are recovery expectations defined for stale revisions and attempts unavailable after instance change or restart? [Recovery, Spec §FR-012–FR-013, §Clarifications]
  - PASS: The [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#operations) provides a stale snapshot and directs clients to start afresh for unavailable attempts.
- [x] CHK019 Are competing guesses and the required atomicity scope sufficiently defined, including concurrent unconnected guesses? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §Operations]
  - PASS: [Data model transitions](../data-model.md#transitions-and-consistency) require process-local atomic revision checks and increment revisions for unconnected guesses.
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements for an unexpected technical failure during an attempted state transition, including any partial-state outcome, specified or explicitly excluded? [Exception Flow, Gap, Constitution §VI]
  - PASS: [Data model transitions](../data-model.md#transitions-and-consistency) require all-or-nothing commits and progress retrieval after an indefinite response.

## Non-Functional Requirements and Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Are the deferred access-control and confidentiality boundaries explicit and consistent across the specification and action contract? [Security, Spec §Assumptions, Contract §Game Server Actions]
  - PASS: The [spec assumptions](../spec.md#assumptions) and [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md) defer access control and promise no attempt privacy.
- [x] CHK022 Are sensitive-data exposure restrictions specified for ordinary outcomes and technical failures? [Security, Spec §FR-003, Contract §Game Server Actions]
  - PASS: The [contract](../contracts/game-actions.md#shared-response-shapes) specifies fixed business messages, full stale snapshots, and exclusions from technical reporting; [FR-003](../spec.md#functional-requirements) restricts early answers.
- [x] CHK023 Are process-local state, lack of cross-instance durability, and the resulting client recovery assumption clearly documented? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Constraints]
  - PASS: [Plan constraints](../plan.md#technical-context) and [spec edge cases](../spec.md#edge-cases) document state loss and fresh-attempt recovery.
- [x] CHK024 Is the absence of performance, throughput, and availability targets a deliberate and consistently documented scope decision? [Non-Functional, Assumption, Plan §Technical Context]
  - PASS: [Plan technical context](../plan.md#technical-context) explicitly excludes production latency, throughput, and availability guarantees.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Add review findings inline and link relevant documentation; IDs are sequential for reference.
